import os
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

filename = "alice_final_exam.pdf"
rubric_version = "v2.3"

artifact_present = os.path.exists(filename)

# Two independent inputs are required to score
inputs_status = pd.DataFrame([
    {"input": "Submission artifact (alice_final_exam.pdf)", "available": artifact_present},
    {"input": "Rubric v2.3 criteria text", "available": False},  # not provided in conversation
    {"input": "Extracted student responses", "available": False}, # depends on artifact
])

print("Scoring prerequisites:")
print(inputs_status.to_string(index=False))
print()
if not artifact_present:
    print("⛔ Scoring BLOCKED: submission artifact not in the environment.")
else:
    print("Artifact found, but rubric v2.3 criterion definitions were not supplied.")
print("No scores produced. No evidence cited. Nothing fabricated.")
```
